_notes:
ST LSM9DS1 9-axis IMU, the magnetometer part at 0x1E (SDO_M high, the Adafruit default) or 0x1C; the accelerometer and gyroscope are a separate I2C device (LSM9DS1AG). 8-bit registers
Detection: WHO_AM_I_M (0x0F) = 0x3D
Init: CTRL_REG2_M (0x21) = 0x04 - software reset, 10 ms; CTRL_REG1_M (0x20) = 0x7C - X and Y ultra-high performance, 80 Hz; CTRL_REG2_M = 0x00 - +/-4 gauss; CTRL_REG4_M (0x23) = 0x0C - Z ultra-high performance; CTRL_REG5_M (0x24) = 0x40 - block data update; CTRL_REG3_M (0x22) = 0x00 - continuous conversion
Poll (100 ms): OUT_X_L_M to OUT_Z_H_M (0x28-0x2D), little-endian 16-bit, 0.14 mgauss per count at +/-4 gauss (71.43 per uT). Multi-byte reads auto-increment with or without the address's top bit set (checked on the bench)
Source: registers from the ST LSM9DS1 datasheet
